name: RedisQA
intro: RedisQA（论文原名 ReDis-QA）是一个罕见病问答基准，包含覆盖 205 种罕见病的 1,360 道高质量选择题，并按疾病及症状、病因、受影响人群、相关疾病、诊断等属性标注元数据。官方协议同时评估直接作答与基于 ReCOP 罕见病语料的检索增强作答。
build_method: 罕见病选择题采集与疾病属性元数据标注；构建 NORD 来源的 ReCOP 检索语料
task_type: 罕见病问答, 医疗诊断
eval_feature: 直接作答与检索增强作答；按疾病属性报告准确率
scale: 1,360 道选择题，覆盖 205 种罕见病
build_method_en: Rare-disease multiple-choice question collection and disease-property metadata annotation; NORD-sourced ReCOP retrieval corpus construction
eval_feature_en: Direct and retrieval-augmented answering with accuracy reported by disease property
intro_en: RedisQA, named ReDis-QA in the paper, is a rare-disease question-answering benchmark with 1,360 high-quality multiple-choice questions covering 205 diseases. Each item is annotated by disease and properties such as symptoms, causes, affected populations, related disorders, and diagnosis; the official protocol evaluates both direct answering and retrieval-augmented answering with the ReCOP corpus.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ReDis-QA arXiv:2408.08422 dataset-construction and evaluation sections, cross-checked against guan-wang/ReDis-QA and ReCOP dataset cards; the catalog ID RedisQA is a casing variant of ReDis-QA. The catalog item RedisQA corresponds to ReDis-QA, not a QuarkMed-created benchmark. The paper collects 1,360 high-quality multiple-choice questions covering 205 rare diseases, annotates each item with disease and question-property metadata, and reports the distribution across symptoms, causes, affected populations, related disorders, diagnosis, and other properties. It also builds ReCOP from NORD rare-disease reports by splitting each report into property-aligned chunks. Models are scored by multiple-choice accuracy in direct and retrieval-augmented settings, with retrieved ReCOP evidence additionally supporting traceable explanations.
